description: opencode local model profiles. This config is intentionally separate from upstream opencode source so frequent upstream updates do not collide with local model work.

gemma-4-e4b.name: Gemma 4 E4B IT
gemma-4-e4b.notes: Expose a slash-free alias such as gemma-4-e4b from your local server.

gemma-4-e2b.name: Gemma 4 E2B IT
gemma-4-e2b.notes: Expose a slash-free alias such as gemma-4-e2b from your local server.

qwen-coder-3b.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct
qwen-coder-3b.notes: Good laptop profile when 7B is too heavy.

llamacpp.note: Start llama-server with --alias matching the selected profile, or set LOCAL_MODEL_ID.

vllm.note: Start vLLM with --served-model-name matching the selected profile, or set LOCAL_MODEL_ID.

mlx-lm.note: Start mlx_lm.server with an MLX model. If the server exposes the Hugging Face repo id, set LOCAL_MODEL_ID to that exact id.

vmlx.note: Start vMLX with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and set LOCAL_MODEL_ID to the model id shown by /v1/models if needed.

omlx.note: Start omlx with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and set LOCAL_MODEL_ID to the model id shown by /v1/models if needed.

vllm-metal.note: Start vLLM with the vllm-metal backend. On macOS this is experimental; set LOCAL_MODEL_ID to the served model name if needed.
